name: Startup Benchmarks

sources.title: Submit — login wall: 'Please sign in to submit your AI tool to our directory'; Google OAuth + email signup
Get started — same login gate; site footer describes it as 'a startup software directory for operations, growth, collaboration, and day-to-day execution'

conditions: An account is required before the submission form is reachable — 'Log in to Submit' gates everything (Google OAuth at /api/auth/google or email signup at /signup)
requirements: Software/startup products across ~55 categories (AI assistants, dev tools, productivity, marketing, finance, etc.)
Account registration is mandatory to submit
Self-described scope: 'startup software for operations, growth, collaboration, and day-to-day execution'
preparation: Account (Google sign-in or email + password at /signup)
Product name, URL, description, category fit, logo/screenshot
Check post-login whether a free tier exists — pricing is not visible before login
workflow: Sign up/log in at https://startupbenchmarks.com/login or /api/auth/google
Fill the product submission form, pick a category, submit
watchFor: The submit form is entirely behind auth — you cannot preview requirements or pricing without an account
Persistent top ad links to submitsaas.com (paid 140+ directory submission service) — likely the operator's upsell; don't confuse it with the site's own free route
Login copy says 'submit your AI tool' though the directory is broader — the site was probably templated from an AI-directory codebase
Post-login there may be a paid/priority tier — unknown until inside
countsAsLive: The product appears on https://startupbenchmarks.com/explore or /latest with its own listing page and outbound link
unknowns: Whether a free tier exists behind the login wall
